entries.rationale: A deterministic empty result with one editable line is useful to every layout consumer.
CR and CRLF remain single hard breaks but output retains indices into the caller's original UTF-16 string.
Trailing whitespace should remain editable without inflating aligned content width.
Whitespace soft wrapping is required for ordinary text.
No-wrap and unbreakable overflow are explicit layout policies.
Break-word and first-line indentation remain independently useful.
Mixed metrics and spacing must produce stable line geometry.
Left alignment is the baseline placement policy.
Center alignment is renderer-neutral.
Right alignment is renderer-neutral.
Justification remains a layout concern, including exclusion of trailing whitespace.
Keeping anchors in layout makes render, measurement, and hit-testing geometry agree.
Per-line visual reordering with logical source identity is essential multilingual behavior.

entries.sourceArea: TextBuilder style ranges and Typesetter run splitting
entries.rationale: Preserve behavior but replace mutable start-index maps with validated half-open spans and stable style keys.
Fallback must operate on grapheme-safe ranges rather than independent code points with only surrogate special-casing.
Preserve block and visible bounds but remove renderer chunk grouping from the layout contract.
Retain editable ligature stops while preventing caret boundaries inside surrogate pairs or combining graphemes.
Pure normalized selection geometry is independently useful.
Line- and direction-aware selection rectangles remain renderer-neutral.
HarfBuzz public shaped runs replace Troika glyph selection while retaining UTF-16 source mapping.
